Common questions

01How does Armature capture sessions?

You add our SDK to your MCP server, Claude Connector or ChatGPT App backend. It takes a few lines and one deploy. From there Armature rebuilds every session, classifies it and scores it automatically.

02Do I have to change my MCP server?

No. You keep the server you already run. The SDK wraps it to capture sessions and changes nothing about how it behaves for your users.

03Which agents and clients do you support?

Any client your users bring: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and the rest. If it can reach your MCP server, Armature can capture the session.

04Can Armature run evals on my MCP too?

Yes. Alongside analytics, Armature runs evals against your MCP server: real agents replay the asks your users send, across models and harnesses, and a judge scores every run against pass criteria you define. You can generate evals from your top use cases and issues, or write them from scratch.

05How is this different from PostHog, Amplitude or Mixpanel?

Those tools track humans clicking your UI. When a user delegates to an agent, the session happens inside Claude or ChatGPT and your UI never sees it. Armature captures exactly those sessions.

06How is this different from LangSmith or Langfuse?

They observe the agents you build yourself, and they serve the engineers who build them. Armature shows product teams how your users' agents experience what you ship.

07Is my users' data safe?

Yes. Detection models scan every session and redact PII and secrets by default, before anything reaches storage. You control retention and can delete your data at any time. Ask us for the full security details, we are happy to share them.

08What does it cost?

It is free up to 1,000 credits a month: 1,000 analytics sessions, 100 eval runs, or any mix, with unlimited projects and users. Past that you pay $50 per 1,000 credits. Custom plans cover teams with serious traffic.

Start improving your agent experience

Capture the sessions users have with your product through any AI agent. See what they ask, watch how agents deliver and fix the issues they encounter. Then run evals that catch regressions before you ship.

联系我们

常见问题

01How does Armature capture sessions?

您将我们的 SDK 添加到您的 MCP 服务器、Claude Connector 或 ChatGPT 应用程序后端。 需要几行代码和一次部署。 从这里开始，Armature 会重建每个会话，对其进行分类并自动评分。

02Do I have to change my MCP server?

不。您保留已经运行的服务器。 SDK 对其进行包装以捕获会话，并且不会改变它对用户的行为方式。

03Which agents and clients do you support?

您的用户带来的任何客户端：Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 等等。 如果它可以到达您的 MCP 服务器，Armature 就可以捕获会话。

04Can Armature run evals on my MCP too?

是的。 除了分析之外，Armature 还会针对您的 MCP 服务器运行评估：真正的代理会跨模型和线束重放用户发送的请求，并且法官会根据您定义的通过标准对每次运行进行评分。 您可以根据最重要的用例和问题生成评估，或从头开始编写它们。

05How is this different from PostHog, Amplitude or Mixpanel?

这些工具会跟踪用户点击您的用户界面。 当用户委托给代理时，会话发生在 Claude 或 ChatGPT 内部，而您的 UI 永远看不到它。 Armature 准确地捕获了这些会话。

06How is this different from LangSmith or Langfuse?

他们观察您自己构建的代理，并为构建它们的工程师提供服务。 Armature 向产品团队展示您的用户代理如何体验您所运送的产品。

07Is my users' data safe?

是的。 默认情况下，在任何内容到达存储之前，检测模型都会扫描每个会话并编辑 PII 和机密。 您可以控制保留并可以随时删除您的数据。 请向我们询问完整的安全详细信息，我们很乐意分享。

08What does it cost?

每月最多免费获得 1,000 个积分：1,000 个分析会话、100 次评估运行或任何组合，项目和用户不受限制。 除此之外，您每 1,000 个积分需支付 50 美元。 定制计划涵盖交通繁忙的团队。

开始改善您的座席体验

通过任何 AI 代理捕获用户与您的产品的会话。 查看他们的要求，观察代理如何交付并解决他们遇到的问题。 然后在发布之前运行评估以捕获回归。
